2026_03_TEN_NYG.headline: Tennessee and New York face a protection-and-field-position test with little margin for wasted drives
2026_03_TEN_NYG.paragraph1: Tennessee and the Giants both need offensive stability more than stylistic fireworks. The Titans can protect their quarterback by creating manageable downs with the run game and quick throws, while New York’s defense should look for pressure opportunities whenever Tennessee falls behind schedule. The Giants face the same constraint against a Titans front capable of punishing obvious passing situations. With both offenses vulnerable to drive-killing plays, sacks, penalties, turnovers and red-zone execution should decide more than total yardage.
2026_03_TEN_NYG.model_rationale: Neither offense wants a high volume of obvious passing downs, so early-down efficiency and turnover avoidance should determine which team controls field position and scoring opportunities.
